note: Derived from shallow clones read on 2026-10-07. Names and identifiers only; descriptions are paraphrased. Discovery and test-design material, not evidence of in-the-wild activity.

defence_patterns.name: Blast Radius Reduction
defence_patterns.description: Assume injection succeeds; restrict what a hijacked LLM can reach (least privilege, access control to backends, fence high-stakes operations, treat all LLM output as untrusted).

defence_patterns.name: Input Pre-processing (Paraphrasing, Retokenization, perturbation e.g. SmoothLLM/JailGuard)
defence_patterns.description: Transform untrusted input before inference so optimised adversarial sequences lose effect; mutation-consistency used for detection.

defence_patterns.name: Guardrails & Overseers, Firewalls & Filters (input/output classifiers, perplexity, action guards, Task Shield)
defence_patterns.description: Monitor inputs and outputs with classifier/LLM guards; gate high-risk actions with dynamic checks; verify each tool call serves the user task.

defence_patterns.name: Canary Tokens & Output Overseer
defence_patterns.description: Embed per-session canary in privileged context; its appearance in output signals prompt leakage/hijack (Rebuff, Vigil).

defence_patterns.name: Taint Tracking
defence_patterns.description: Track trust level of data ingested by the model and reduce capabilities as taint increases; flag tainted data reaching sensitive sinks.

defence_patterns.name: Secure Threads / Dual LLM (Privileged + Quarantined)
defence_patterns.description: Privileged LLM sees only trusted input and plans actions; quarantined LLM processes untrusted content with no tools; data passed by reference/structured values.

defence_patterns.name: Ensemble Decisions / Mixture of Experts (incl. MELON masked re-execution)
defence_patterns.description: Cross-check decisions across independent models or re-execute with masked user prompt to detect actions driven by injected content.

defence_patterns.name: Prompt Engineering / Instructional Defense (spotlighting, delimiters/random enclosure, sandwich, instruction hierarchy, signed prompts, templated output, API/model-level role segmentation)
defence_patterns.description: Mark provenance of untrusted data and structure prompts/roles so model prioritises privileged instructions; constrain outputs to templates. Weak alone (see critiques).

defence_patterns.name: Robustness, Finetuning (task-specific finetune e.g. Jatmo, StruQ, control vectors)
defence_patterns.description: Train/finetune or steer models so they do not follow instructions embedded in data.

defence_patterns.name: Preflight "injection test"
defence_patterns.description: Concatenate untrusted input to a known test prompt; deviation from expected deterministic output signals injection.

defence_patterns.name: Database permission hardening / query rewriting (Critiques & Papers section)
defence_patterns.description: Rewrite LLM-generated SQL to operate only on data the user is authorised for; DB-level least privilege.

defence_patterns.name: CaMeL: Control/data-flow separation via privileged LLM generating code for a restricted interpreter
defence_patterns.description: P-LLM sees only the user query and emits a program; untrusted tool data never alters control flow, only flows as values through a custom interpreter.

defence_patterns.name: CaMeL: Quarantined LLM with schema-constrained output and no tool access
defence_patterns.description: Untrusted unstructured data is parsed by a tool-less Q-LLM into a typed Pydantic schema, with an explicit not-enough-information signal instead of guessing.

defence_patterns.name: CaMeL: Capability metadata on values (sources + readers) propagated through dependencies
defence_patterns.description: Every value carries provenance (User, CaMeL, TrustedToolSource, Tool with inner sources) and allowed readers (Public or set); dependencies propagate tags.

defence_patterns.name: CaMeL: Per-tool security policy engine, default-deny, side-effect-free tool exemption
defence_patterns.description: Before a state-changing tool runs, policies (fnmatch on tool name) inspect argument capabilities; deny if non-public dependencies or no policy matches (e.g. recipient must be able to read data; deletion target must come from user).

proposed_controls.name: Input/Output Injection & Policy Classifier
proposed_controls.description: Run a dedicated classifier/guard model (and heuristics such as perplexity) on untrusted inputs and on model outputs/tool calls; log verdicts; never rely on it as sole control (defence-in-depth, measure false-positive/over-defence).

proposed_controls.name: Privileged-Context Canary Tokens
proposed_controls.description: Insert unique per-session canaries into system prompts/secret-bearing context and alert when they appear in output, tool arguments or egress (pairs with DET-AI-010).

proposed_controls.name: Privileged / Quarantined LLM Separation
proposed_controls.description: Planner model with tool access only sees trusted instructions; untrusted content is processed by a tool-less model returning schema-typed values that cannot alter control flow.

proposed_controls.name: Data-Flow Provenance and Taint Policy
proposed_controls.description: Attach source/reader capability tags to all data, propagate through derivations, and deny side-effecting tool calls whose arguments depend on untrusted or non-shareable data unless an explicit policy allows it (default deny).

proposed_controls.name: Task-Alignment Verification of Agent Actions
proposed_controls.description: Verify each planned tool call contributes to the user-stated goal (Task Shield) or remains stable when untrusted context is masked/re-executed (MELON) or cross-checked by an independent model.

proposed_controls.name: Untrusted Input Transformation and Spotlighting
proposed_controls.description: Mark/encode untrusted content (spotlighting, datamarking, random delimiters) and optionally paraphrase/retokenize/normalise (Unicode, invisible chars) before inference.

proposed_controls.name: Typed / Templated Model Output
proposed_controls.description: Constrain model output to schemas/enums/templates validated by deterministic code before use (complements CTRL-OUTPUT-SANITIZATION).

proposed_controls.name: Model Injection-Robustness Selection and Evaluation
proposed_controls.description: Select/finetune models with instruction-hierarchy or injection-resistant training and re-evaluate with adversarial suites (e.g., AgentDojo-style) on each model/version change.
